newsitem.title: USA: IPO Filing - Iridium World Communications Ltd.
newsitem.headline: IPO Filing - Iridium World Communications Ltd.

text.p: Iridium World Communications Ltd filed Monday with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 10 million Class A common shares in an initial public offering.
Of the total amount, eight million Class A shares are being offered in the United States and Canada and two million shares are being offered on the international market.
The offering is estimated to be priced between $19 and $21 per share. After the offering, outstanding Class A will total 10,000,000 common.

The U.S. underwriters have been offered a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to an additional 1.2 million Class A shares while the international managers were offered an additional 300,000 Class A shares.
The offering will be made through Merrill Lynch, Donaldson Lufkin and Jenrette Securities Corp and Goldman Sachs & Co.
Net proceeds will be used to purchase Class 1 interests in Iridium relating to the terms of the 1997 subscription agreement, the filing said.

Proceeds from the sale of Class 1 interests will be used to make milestone payments under the space system contract and the terrestrial network development contract and for other general corporate purposes.
Iridium has applied to trade on Nasdaq under the stock symbol "IRIDF".

Iridium World is a member of Iridium LLC, an international consortium of 17 companies and organizations including Motorola, Sprint Corp, Lockheed Martin and Raytheon Co. Iridium LLC, based in Bermuda, is developing and commercializing a global mobile wireless communications system that will enable subscribers to send and receive telephone calls.
